targets.old_statement: The application of a written-test applicant under 18 must be signed and approved by a parent, a guardian appointed by a court, a foster parent appointed by a county, or the director of the transitional living program where the teen lives, with documentation if the signer is not a parent; a completed Supplemental Parental Curriculum certificate is also brought.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The application of a written-test applicant under eighteen must be signed and approved by a parent, a guardian appointed by a court, a foster parent appointed by a county, or the director of the transitional living program where the teen lives, with documentation if the signer is not a parent; a completed Supplemental Parental Curriculum certificate is also brought.
targets.statement: Written test applicants under eighteen must be at least fifteen, bring a Blue Card or Pink Card, bring the Supplemental Parental Curriculum completion certificate if completed, and have an approved adult sign the application with documentation when not a parent.
